source: The state of your physical health is described in two ways:
target: 你的身体健康状况通过两种方式描述：

source: The Supreme Wizard of the Cult of Starry Wisdom. He appears incredibly old, like a hideous ancient vampire or a grim reaper. Tattered crimson robes flow from his skeletal frame, his bony fingers extends into razor sharp claws, and he has a grim expression on his face.
target: 星辰智慧教团的大巫师。他看起来极其年迈，宛如一只可怖的古老吸血鬼或冷酷的死神。破烂的深红长袍垂挂在他骨瘦如柴的身躯上，骨指化作锋利的爪子，脸上满是阴沉神情。

source: The tale of a lost civilization's final days.
target: 失落文明末日时日的故事。

source:
The walls here are slick with dampness, and the air is heavy with the stench of saltwater and the unmistakable odor of decay. I can feel the humidity on my skin, and my breaths come out in shallow gasps. 

There are tunnels leading deeper into underground waterways, but I can only guess where they might lead. It's as if the entire cave system is interconnected, with passages that could possibly lead to the depths of the ocean or subterranean lakes and rivers.
target:
这里的墙壁湿滑，空气中弥漫着沉重的盐水与腐朽气息。我能感到皮肤上的湿气，呼吸也变得短促。

有隧道通往更深处的地下水道，但我只能猜测它们通向何方。整个洞穴系统似乎彼此相连，通道也许会通往海洋深处，或地下湖泊与河流。

source: The webs spun by this transcendental creature are not of any mundane kind - weaving, plucking, gnawing, it taps directly into the fabric of fate, making baleful arrangements according to its ulterior whims.
target: 这超凡生物织出的蛛网绝非凡物——它编织、拨弄、啃噬，直接触及命运的织布，并依循隐秘私欲，编排出不祥的结局。

source: There are also other ways you can lose Spirit, for example some monsters can drain your Spirit with their attacks.
target: 你也可能因其他原因失去精神值，例如有些怪物的攻击会汲取精神力。

source: There are black zones of shadow close to our daily paths, and now and then some evil soul breaks a passage through. When that happens, the man who knows must strike before reckoning the consequences.
target: 在我们日常行经之处附近，潜藏着黑暗的阴影区域；偶尔会有邪恶灵魂打通一道通路。一旦如此，知情者必须在考量后果之前先行出手。

source: There are horrors beyond life's edge that we do not suspect, and once in a while man's evil prying calls them just within our range.
target: 生命边界之外潜藏着我们未曾察觉的恐怖；偶尔，人类邪恶的窥探会将它们引到我们身边。

source: There are no more items of interest.
target: 没有更多值得关注的物品了。

source: There is a briny smell here.
There is a carved rock defiled with blasphemous carvings here. It must be destroyed!
target: 这里有块刻着亵渎图案的石头。必须摧毁它！

source: There is a carved rock here.
There is a fountain here, but it's dried-up.
target: 这里有一座喷泉，不过已经干涸了。

source: There is a glass surface here.
There is a half-dissolved human body inside!
target: 里面有一具半溶解的人体！

source: There is a stench of decayed flesh here.
There is a stone box here.
There is a strange itch, as if something is crawling on the back of my neck.
target: 我感到一阵奇痒，仿佛有什么东西正在脖颈后面爬动。

source: There is a temple gong here.
There is an alchemist's workbench here.
target: 这里有一张炼金术士的工作台。

source:
There is an inscription here, studying it will yield some experience.

It may also recall a spell that you have forgotten, or reveal something about carried manuscripts or potions. The chance to reveal information about such items is higher with more unknown items carried.
target:
这里有一段铭文，研究它可以获得一些经验。

它还可能让你回忆起遗忘的法术，或揭示随身携带的手稿、药水的信息。你携带的未知物品越多，揭示这类信息的几率就越高。

source: There is an intense flash of light!

There is an item called a "Medical Bag", which has a certain number of "supplies". When activated, it can be used to either sanitize an infection, treat a WOUND, or do a quick patch-up that restores some Hit Points. When bitten or clawed by certain monsters, you can become Infected; This should be treated before the infection turns into a disease! Treating infections or doing a quick patch-up only require a few supplies, while treating wounds requires more.
target: 有一种叫作“医疗包”的物品，内含一定数量的“补给”。启动后可用于消毒感染、治疗创伤，或快速包扎以恢复一些生命值。被某些怪物咬伤或抓伤后可能会感染；必须在感染发展成疾病前进行治疗！治疗感染或快速包扎只需少量补给，治疗创伤则需要更多。

source: There is nothing of value inside.
There is suddenly a crushing pressure in the air!
target: 空气中骤然出现一股沉重的压迫感！

source: They are very flammable, and will quickly ignite other nearby flammable creatures
target: 它们极易燃烧，也会迅速点燃附近其他可燃生物

source: They cannot visually detect other creatures
target: 它们无法通过视觉发现其他生物

source: They emit light and can be seen in darkness
target: 它们会发光，即使在黑暗中也能被看见
它们会随时间恢复生命值

source: They worshipped, so they said, the Great Old Ones who lived ages before there were any men, and who came to the young world out of the sky...
target: 据说他们崇拜远古众神——那些在人类出现很久以前便已存在、从天而降来到这个年轻世界的古老存在……

source: This evil artifact must be destroyed!
target: 必须摧毁这件邪恶神器！

source: This former corpse has been granted a twisted gift of wings, resembling those of a monstrous bat. Awkward and ungainly in its newfound aerial ability, it navigates the air with unsteady movements. Despite its diminished agility and imprecise strikes, this abomination remains a formidable threat, driven by an insatiable hunger for the living.
target: 这具旧尸体被赋予了一双扭曲的翅膀，形似巨蝠。它刚获得飞行能力，动作笨拙而不协调，只能在空中摇摇晃晃地移动。尽管灵活性下降、攻击也不精准，这个怪物依然极具威胁，因为它对活物有着永不满足的饥渴。

source: This is merely a convenience feature - you can just as well use items by selecting them from the "i" screen, but with this method you get a nice filtered list so you can see at a glance which consumables you have.
target: 这只是方便功能——你也可以从“i”界面选择物品使用；但通过此方式会显示筛选后的列表，让你一眼看清自己有哪些消耗品。

source: This living fossil appears to have crept unchanged from the dawn of time through untold millions of years. Both a predator and a scavenger, it bites and tears with voracious jaws.
target: 这块活化石似乎从时间的黎明起便一成不变地爬行了数百万年。它既是捕食者也是食腐动物，会用贪婪的颚齿撕咬猎物。

source: This man-rodent beast slinks through cracks in the church's walls and pounces on its victims, raking at their flesh with its undeveloped limbs. Being the black matron's mongrel of choice, it titters senselessly whenever it feasts on her blood.
target: 这个人鼠混种会从教堂墙壁的裂缝中悄然溜出，扑向受害者，用尚未发育完全的肢体抓挠血肉。它是黑色母亲最中意的杂种，每当吸食她的血液时便会傻笑。

source: This miserable thing was a failed attempt at the reanimation of dead flesh. Perhaps necrosis had advanced too far before the process started, or this was a wild experiment performed by one who lacked proper knowledge of the principles involved. It lumbers about aimlessly with a vacant expression, which gives it something of a calm appearance - although the twitch in its clawed fingers is something to be wary of.
target: 这可怜的东西是复活尸体的失败尝试。也许是开始仪式前尸体已经严重坏死，或是操作者缺乏必要知识而胡乱实验。它茫然地漫无目的游荡，表情空洞，看起来颇为平静——不过那带爪手指的抽搐仍值得警惕。

source: This progress is called experience, or "XP"

This represents minor injuries such as bruises, sprains, or light bleeding - and also general combat morale, fatigue, stance, etc. If your Hit Points reach 0, it means you received a killing blow, or the circumstances are such that you can no longer fight back (you are fallen, pinned or completely exhausted). Hit Points usually regenerate automatically over time.
target: 这表示瘀伤、扭伤、轻微流血等小伤，以及总体战斗士气、疲劳、姿势等状态。如果生命值降至0，说明你受到了致命一击，或已经倒地、被压制、精疲力竭，无法继续战斗。生命值通常会随时间自动恢复。

source: This represents more serious long-term damage. Wounds are received when you take a high amount of damage in one hit. Each Wound reduces your fighting abilities, maximum HP, and HP regeneration rate. Five concurrent wounds results in death.
target: 这表示更严重的长期损伤。一次受到大量伤害时会产生创伤。每处创伤都会削弱战斗能力、降低生命值上限和生命值恢复速度。同时有五处创伤就会死亡。

source: This rock is defiled with blasphemous carvings, it must be destroyed!
target: 这块石头刻有亵渎图案，必须摧毁！

source: This rotting thing appears to have been brought back to life through some abominable process. It has grown sharp claws to attack with.
target: 这个腐烂的东西似乎通过某种可憎的手段死而复生。它长出了锋利的爪子用于攻击。

source: This sub-species has adapted to thriving in particularly deep environments where very little light reaches. They are even more fierce than their counterparts who dwell closer to the surface. Their mouths are set with rows of serrated teeth, well-adapted for cutting through flesh. However, they are cowardly opportunistic creatures, prefering to stalk lonely prey that they perceive as an easy target - when met with violence, they will usually retreat, at least for a moment.
target: 这个亚种适应了几乎没有光线的极深环境，比栖居在较浅处的同类更加凶猛。它们的口中长满锯齿，善于撕裂血肉。然而它们生性怯懦，只会伏击孤独且容易下手的猎物；一旦遭遇反抗，通常就会暂时撤退。

source: This unholy instrument must be destroyed!
target: 必须摧毁这件亵渎圣物！

source: This weapon does not use ammo.
To add fonts, place them in this directory.
target: 要添加字体，请将其放入此目录。

source: to be defined, but it was not found
target: 应当已定义，但没有找到

source: To cast memorized spells, press "x" to open a menu for selecting which spell to cast. In this menu you can see the Spirit cost per spell (the cost is a range of values, and the spirit drained is a random value in this range), and your skill level for each spell (Occultist characters can learn to cast spells at higher levels by picking certain traits).
target: 若要施放记忆中的法术，按“x”打开法术选择菜单。在菜单中可以查看每个法术消耗的精神值（消耗是一个范围，实际汲取量会在范围内随机决定）以及对应的技能等级（神秘学者角色可通过选择某些特质提升法术等级）。

source: To my alarm, I find myself encouraged by the pain I cause in others. For every significant life I take, I find a little relief. However, my depraved mind will never find complete peace.
target: 令我惊恐的是，我发现自己竟从造成他人痛苦中得到鼓舞。每夺去一个重要生命，我都会感到一丝宽慰。然而，我堕落的心智永远无法获得彻底平静。

source: tried to move into a position with monster
target: 试图移动到有怪物的位置

source: tried to move into terrain it cannot move into:
target: 试图移动到无法进入的地形：

source: u (G)     UNLOAD firearm on the ground, or pick up item
target: u (G)     将枪械卸到地上，或拾取物品
不会受到震撼事件影响。
